newsitem.title: USA: Banc One shareholders approve acquisition.
newsitem.headline: Banc One shareholders approve acquisition.

text.p: Shareholders of Banc One Corp Thursday approved a proposal for the company to acquire First USA Inc, a spokesman said.

The spokesman said shareholders also approved boosting the authorized common shares by 350 million to 900 million shares. The increase in shares is primarily to facilitate the closing of the $7 billion acquisition.
First USA shareholdes are scheduled to vote on the transaction at a meeting Friday in Dallas.
Asked when the deal will close, the Banc One spokesman said "our intention is to close before the end of the month and we've indicated we'd like to close sometime tomorrow."
An activist group called Inner City Press/Community on the Move has filed a lawsuit in the U.S. Circut Court of Appeals in Washington D.C. seeking to block the merger.
The group is seeking to vacate the Federal Reserve Board's approval of the merger, alleging that there were discriminatory lending practices at units of Banc One which were not addressed.
